book.name: 1 Kolint
book.title: Pol-ate kaapiya nyendoos la vu hil bel-ate vu Kolint

content: Salivangin sen dôôvu Anutu-te hil-ato
+ o 16:1 Lom 15:25-26; 2Ko 8:1-9; Gal 2:10*Ke, tonde mone sen ham naasupin in nambe ham andôôvu Anutu-te hil-ato, ond yik ham ambiing nohvu saanêêl vu hil bel-ate sen dando Galataa-to.
Ham ti ti pin ham akam bu nohvu Sonda pin naambe ham nako mone vilis, ond ham anôôh vaalu vêêl-ambe mando in nambe sa naas vu ham ond ham-ame mosalo salivangin e.
Om ham oo anggolin hamate omaaheey, in sa naas vu ham ond sa kaavu kaapiya be saambu be sil gako gaving hamate salivangin-anja be lana Yelusalem.
Le naambe sa kangg bu naambe sana gaving ond hey ahondoos e ana.
Pol nêêl nambe na ji hil Kolint
+ o 16:5 Sin 19:21*Sa navu ana gatup hôôk Makedonia-te taaku, om sanaa-ju vêêl e mem sa naas vu ham-anja.

+ o 16:6 Lom 15:24; Tit 3:12*Om sa naas balup atombe sale mando gaving ham daka le. Êê-e, mak sale mando be kwaav vaalu sen lôôy osin vavi bopaataa-to jung na, le mem ham andôôvu sa in mop sen sanaa-to be sana jak.
+ o 16:7 Sin 18:21*De sa naas balup ond sa nimbaya nambe same aangge ham amu be sana pavis e, nganjo saawiingin nambe Omaaho Bop jiinggis ond sale mando gaving ham ahusaandiin daka le.
Lemu saawiingin nambe mando Epesas-anjo be Pentikos jung na le.
+ o 16:9 Sin 19:8-10; 2Ko 2:12; Kol 4:3; Taato 3:8*In saahe nambe sate kul bopaata neep-anjo be lohvu nambe nyiis nôôn ngeeyaata, le hil sen dayi sa payaa-to ngeeyaata dando having.
+ o 16:10 1Ko 4:17*De Timoti naas balup vu ham ond yik ham gako yi jak nivasa, in nambe mando gaving ham osin ka vasa, in yik nawiing Omaaho Bop-ate kul nambe saa-to.

+ o 16:11 1Ti 4:12*Ham ti me-ji Timoti naambe va malis-ande galuuh dami vu yi le, nganjo ham andôôvu yi be naanggiiy na mop osin vakasin melaas-ambe nom vu sa, in sa monatung mengg in yi in nambe gaving yiiy halingg-aso vaalu be lanaam.

+ o 16:12 1Ko 1:12; 3:6*Tonde yiiy halingg Apolo, ond saanjinj lôôt nambe gaving yiiy halingg-aso vaalu be lanaas vu ham, le ma de gêên ond me-wiingin nambe naas vu ham daka le, om yoo le mando be naatovu mop ond mem le naas.
Vakasin ahus heey
+ o 16:13 Saam 31:24; Ep 6:10*Ham amem naatum-ambe ham ambiing gaving niwêêk, osin ham naatu hil aniwêêk keen-ambe ham baale niwêêk.
De va pin sen ham nawiing-ato ond ham oo ambiing osin ham ahem gaving omaahonôôn.

+ o 16:15 Lom 16:5; 1Ko 1:16*Halingg-aso, ham alak ni nambe Stepanas having yite hil, ond sil lawii-having Kalisi munggin hil pin vu taaku bop Akaia, tombe mem sil lavu sil la osin doos-ambe mondahôôvu Anutu-te hil. Om sale naanêêl vu ham naambe
+ o 16:16 1Tes 5:12*ham nanyem vuun vu hil naambêênju, de vu hil sen dahôôvu sil-ambe dawiing kul bop having-ato.
Sa kangg vasa in Stepanas ayuuh Potunetas-ande Akaikas lalaam-anjo, in ham-ame alohvu nambe anaam-anjo le, om yaal lako ham amem-ambe yaal lalaam.
+ o 16:18 Pil 2:29*Tombe yaal lawiing-ambe ham alompayo ahelavis ak-ambe sa longgpayo ahelavis ak having, om ham gako hil nambêênja haalend jak.

+ o 16:19 Sin 18:2,18,26; Lom 16:3-5*Ke, hil bel-ate lu ti ti sen dando Esiaa-to kand navu ham, tonde Akwila yuuh vane Plisila osin hil bel-ate sen dasupin sil hôôk yuuh ambaand-ambe dalohak-ato, ond kand navu ham lôôt having, in Omaaho Bop-ate hil ham pin.
+ o 16:20 Lom 16:16; 2Ko 13:12*Tonde yik Omaaho Bop-ate hil pin akand navu ham having. De ham sen ham atu Anutu-te hil-ato ond ham samu ham vaha-vahaan in taato naambe ham ahem naving ham.
+ o 16:21 Kol 4:18; 2Tes 3:17*Tonde sa Pol, ond soo kaavu vakasin ahus dakaa-jo lak sa namangg-ambe sa naanêêl naambe Anutu mando gaving ham.
+ o 16:22 Gal 1:8-9*Omaaho ti nambe ahe me-gaving Omaaho Bop e, ond Anutu talôôt yi be na menama. O Omaaho Bop, ganaam.
Yik vakasin lung laa-ja. Yate Omaaho Bop Yesu-te samu samu naas mando gaving ham.
Ke, sahengg oo naving ham pin in Yesu Kalisi duuh yiiy pin lavuh ti.
